_comment: Official large-monster counts per game, used by tools/audit.py to gauge whether monster-hunter-DB's coverage is complete. Numbers are the franchise-recognized totals (large monsters only), cross-checked against the Monster Hunter Fandom wiki per-game 'Monsters' pages and community tallies. Update these if Capcom adds monsters or if a count is found inaccurate. 'mhdb_game' is the game_full string in monster-hunter-DB's monsters.json that the count should be reconciled against; MHW/MHRise roll their expansions (Iceborne/Sunbreak) into one entry, matching how monster-hunter-DB stores them.
